title: You can now mod Claude Code like a video game

slides.headline: You can now *mod* Claude Code like a video game.
slides.alt: A Claude Code prompt with a pixel health bar above it and a MOD LOADED sticker, for Claude Code mods.
slides.visual: a Claude Code window with a game HUD (hearts and XP bar) above the real install command, and a MOD LOADED sticker

slides.headline: Your coding session can have a *health bar.*
slides.body: One popular mod turns your usage into health and your context window into XP.
slides.visual: a HUD: ten pixel hearts for usage and a segmented XP bar for the context window

slides.headline: A mod runs *inside* Claude Code.
slides.body: Hooks only watch. Mods can change what happens next.
slides.visual: a flow: tool call goes into your mod, which can run it, rewrite it or skip it

slides.headline: Equip one and it can *change* anything.
slides.visual: four inventory slots: redraw the interface, pause rm -rf before it runs (equipped), add your own /command, play Doom while it works

slides.headline: Mods aren't sandboxed. *Check first.*
slides.body: They run with your permissions. Only install from sources you trust.
slides.visual: a terminal running claude plugin validate with comments listing every event it hooks and every API call it makes

slides.headline: Send this to your team's *first modder.*
slides.visual: a Before you install checklist: trusted source, ran validate, added blast-radius
